quotes.text: There are different powers on the earth whereby miracles are wrought, and some of them perhaps according to the science of heaven, yet not acknowledged of God, because they are illegal, unauthorized, and in some instances, sought to be exercised against the sons of God. As Balaam, whom Balak sought
